story.title: Shooting Near Florida A&M University Injures 12, Including 6 Children
story.summary: A shooting near Florida A&M University's Bragg Memorial Stadium resulted in 12 injuries, including six children. Police reported that at least 11 of the injured sustained gunshot wounds. Preliminary investigations indicate that a fight broke out prior to the shooting, which occurred during homecoming celebrations.

explore_lenses.label: Why did the shooting disrupt homecoming?
explore_lenses.title: It happened beside a crowded event area
explore_lenses.summary: The shooting occurred near, not on, FAMU’s campus shortly after its homecoming football game. Its proximity to Bragg Memorial Stadium and the number of child victims made it a broader public-safety emergency during one of the university’s busiest weekends.

claims.text: Police responded just before 8 p.m. on October 24 near Perry and Manatee streets; local reporting places Perry Street steps from Bragg Memorial Stadium, after the homecoming game ended around 6 p.m.
Chief Lawrence Revell said roughly two dozen officers were already in the area when gunfire began, reflecting the planned law-enforcement presence for the busy weekend.
FAMU said the incident was near campus and that campus remained safe, while urging people to avoid the area during the police response.

explore_lenses.uncertainty_note: Authorities have not established that the shooting was connected to the football game, homecoming programming, or FAMU itself.

explore_lenses.label: What is known about the confrontation?
explore_lenses.title: Police have only a preliminary sequence
explore_lenses.summary: Investigators have identified an altercation before the shooting, but have not publicly established its cause, participants, or who fired. The available account remains preliminary rather than a confirmed motive narrative.

claims.text: TPD said its early findings indicate that a physical altercation occurred before the shooting.
Revell told reporters the altercation appeared to involve two or three people, but also said police did not yet know what happened.
As of the October 25 update, police had announced no arrest, suspect, or person of interest.

explore_lenses.label: What happens next in the investigation?
explore_lenses.title: Detectives are seeking evidence and witnesses
explore_lenses.summary: TPD’s Violent Crimes Unit is leading the case, while officers seek public information to reconstruct events and identify those responsible. Updates to victim conditions and any charging decisions depend on the continuing investigation.

claims.text: TPD says its Violent Crimes Unit has assumed the investigation and detectives are gathering evidence and speaking with witnesses.
TPD forecasts that detectives will determine the circumstances of the shooting and identify those responsible; the department asks witnesses to contact police or Crime Solvers anonymously.
In a Sunday morning update reported by WCTV, five victims had been released, six remained hospitalized, and one remained in critical condition.

story_report.summary: A shooting near Florida A&M University’s Bragg Memorial Stadium in Tallahassee injured 12 people, including six children, police said. At least 11 victims suffered gunshot wounds, and the youngest was 11. Police responded shortly before 8 p.m. on Oct. 24 near Perry and Manatee streets, after the homecoming game had ended; early findings indicate a physical altercation preceded the gunfire.

sections.heading: Police presence near Bragg Stadium
sections.body: Chief Lawrence Revell said roughly two dozen officers were already in the area when the gunfire began, part of a planned law-enforcement presence for the busy homecoming weekend. FAMU said the incident occurred near campus and that the campus remained safe, while urging people to avoid the area during the police response.

sections.heading: Victims remain hospitalized after shooting
sections.body: In a Sunday morning update, five victims had been released, six remained hospitalized and one person was in critical condition. The Tallahassee Police Department’s Violent Crimes Unit is leading the investigation, with detectives collecting evidence and interviewing witnesses. Police have asked witnesses to contact the department or submit anonymous tips through Crime Solvers.

unresolved.text: Authorities have not established whether the shooting was connected to the football game, homecoming events or FAMU itself.

Police had announced no arrest, suspect or person of interest as of the Oct. 25 update. The motive, the identities and roles of people involved in the altercation, the number of shooters and whether victims were intended targets remain unresolved.

related_stories.title: Israel Implements Restrictions in West Bank Ahead of Elections Following Soldier Deaths
related_stories.summary: In the lead-up to elections, Israel has announced the closure of all land crossings between Israel and the West Bank on election day. This decision follows a deadly attack in Hebron that resulted in the deaths of two Israeli soldiers. Concurrently, Israeli military operations have led to the displacement of approximately 1,200 Palestinians from their homes in Hebron, as part of a broader crackdown in response to the attack.
